title: Nazi submarine traffic intercepted near Patagonia
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Nazi submarine traffic intercepted near Patagonia, about 1946 at Patagonia, Argentina, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: intercepted Nazi submarine traffic going uh to Argentina right around Patagonia.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher and author, says that around 1946, after World War II had ended, Nazi submarine traffic was intercepted heading to Argentina, near Patagonia, the country's far southern region. If true, it would mean Nazis and their secrets kept moving to South America after Germany's defeat.
